prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1041; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to what happened, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, I'll note you're the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision. Can you describe where you were when it happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection on a green light. I had just passed the gas station on the corner.

Q: Okay. What happened next?

A: A pickup came from my right side and ran the red light. I saw it at the last second and tried to brake, but it hit my driver's side door.

Q: Did you have any time to avoid it?

A: Not really. It all happened very fast. I heard the horn and then there was a loud bang and my car spun a little.

Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

A: I don't think I fully blacked out, but I was dazed. I remember the airbag going off and I couldn't focus for a while.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room that evening. They told me I have a concussion. I've been having headaches and I get dizzy when I look at screens for too long.

Q: Are you currently taking any medication for the concussion?

A: They gave me something for the headaches, and my doctor said to rest and avoid driving for a while.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm not at fault. The other driver admitted at the scene that they didn't see the light change.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
